name: Heat food
description: Bring food to a target temperature with an appliance and switch the heat off: in the closed microwave (start key + wait) or in a pot on the stove burner (power key on, wait, power key off).

food.description: The food item (has task-level thermal state).

precheck.name: hand_empty
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: base_near
precheck.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: in_appliance
precheck.meaning: Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: is_closed
precheck.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

precheck.name: in_cookware_on_burner
precheck.meaning: Food is inside a container whose bottom rests on the stove burner disc (or on the disc itself).
precheck.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

verifier.name: temperature_at_least
verifier.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or above the threshold.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.name: heating
verifier.meaning: The appliance's heat source is on (microwave cycle or stove burner).
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

paths.note: Food must be inside a pot (or pan) whose bottom rests on the burner.

relations.when: the heated food is taken out of the microwave
no microwave is available: heat in a pot on the stove
relations.reason: Same verb, other noun: the stove path pours/places the food into the pot first.

relations.when: the food is not in the appliance
the food is still below the target when the time budget ends
relations.reason: keep the heat on longer, then re-check the temperature

relations.when: the food is in a cup, not in the pot on the burner
relations.reason: pouring the cup into the pot on the burner puts the food in the heated vessel

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
